projects.title: ITA Challenges Platform
projects.description: A collaborative, microservices-based platform for programming challenges, built by a team of academy students.
projects.longDescription: Contributed to the backend development of this multi-service platform. Gained hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot, and MongoDB in a real-world team environment following agile methodologies. The system features JWT authentication and is designed to handle coding challenge submissions and evaluations.
features: Collaborative development in a multi-repository project
Production deployment and team workflow experience

projects.title: PDFGigs - Sheet Music Manager
projects.description: Hexagonal architecture application for musicians to manage PDF scores with reactive backend.
projects.longDescription: Full-stack application implementing Hexagonal Architecture (Ports & Adapters) with Spring WebFlux. Features domain-driven design, clear separation of concerns, and Minecraft-themed UI. Built with reactive programming for non-blocking I/O operations. Currently in active development with focus on clean architecture patterns.
features: Reactive REST API with Spring WebFlux
